paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将4.6g氢氧化钠(96％，0.11mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钠分散均匀后，控制釜温在40℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为40℃，反应5h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为96.4％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Add 200 mL of tert-butanol to the reaction flask, start stirring, and at room temperature drip in 4.6 g of sodium hydroxide (96％, 0.11 mol). After the sodium hydroxide has dispersed uniformly, control the kettle temperature at 40℃ and pour 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1 mol) into the kettle to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction is slightly exothermic; control the kettle temperature at 40℃ and react for 5 h. After the reaction ends, liquid chromatography in-process control gives a normalised content of 96.4％ for the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate. The solvent is stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material is used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: This is the tail of Example 4 step (1); the example header itself is on an earlier page. The printed line break puts a wide gap between 34.8g and 2-氯; the text layer renders it as two spaces, which is a justification artifact, not a character.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid. The main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: The Chinese name places the (2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy) group before 甲基 (methyl), i.e. it is literally '3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl', meaning a 3-CH2-O-CH2CF3 side chain. Translated literally.
Marker carries no prose; it labels the reaction scheme drawn to its right (drawing 1).

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入130mL DMF、10.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.105mol)和14.1g叔丁醇钾(95％，0.12mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在10℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(96.4％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.5g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为98.0％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.4％。
paragraphs.en: Add 130 mL of DMF, 10.6 g of trifluoroethanol (99％, 0.105 mol) and 14.1 g of potassium tert-butoxide (95％, 0.12 mol) to the reaction kettle, start stirring, control the kettle temperature at 10℃, and add the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (96.4％, 0.1 mol) to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3 h; after addition is complete, hold at temperature and react for 4 h. When the reaction is complete, strip the solvent under reduced pressure, add 120 mL of water to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2. Then filter, rinse with water and dry to obtain 32.5 g of product. HPLC assay gives a content of 98.0％ for the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, for a two-step reaction yield of 91.4％ based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: The text layer prints '14 .1g' and '130mL  DMF' with extra spaces; the image shows 14.1g and a single wide gap before DMF, so these are justification artifacts.

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇350mL，开动搅拌，室温下将6.9g氢氧化钾(85％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钾分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应7h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为98.3％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Add 350 mL of tert-butanol to the reaction flask, start stirring, and at room temperature drip in 6.9 g of potassium hydroxide (85％, 0.105 mol). After the potassium hydroxide has dispersed uniformly, control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and pour 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1 mol) into the kettle to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction is slightly exothermic; control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and react for 7 h. After the reaction ends, liquid chromatography in-process control gives a normalised content of 98.3％ for the potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate. The solvent is stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material is used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: The text layer prints '350mL ' and '6 .9g' with extra spaces from justification; the image shows 350mL and 6.9g.

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入150mL三氟乙醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入20g氢化钾(30％，0.15mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经脱溶后得到三氟乙醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
paragraphs.en: Add 150 mL of trifluoroethanol to the reaction kettle, start stirring, and at room temperature charge 20 g of potassium hydride (30％, 0.15 mol). Stir until completely dissolved; after stripping off the solvent, potassium trifluoroethoxide solid is obtained and sealed for later use.
paragraphs.notes: 氢化钾 translates literally as potassium hydride. 20 g at 30％ and 0.15 mol implies a formula mass near 40, which fits potassium hydroxide (56 at 100％ would give 0.107 mol; KH is 40.1), so the Chinese may be a misprint for 氢氧化钾. Translated literally rather than corrected; the paragraph continues past the bottom of this page.
